So the true figures are 200 affected stamps (filed: 126) and 83 with a live sibling (filed: 51) — the filer UNDER-CLAIMED by ~1.6x on both. They are two halves of one trap and neither is safe to fix alone — fixing only the over-fire leaves existing bad closures stuck; fixing only the reopen path leaves the source of them running.
